### **AI-Powered Development Acceleration**

```python
# Elite Developer Experience Core
from terrafusion.developer_experience import (
    AICodeAssistant,
    PredictiveDevelopment,
    GovernmentDevExcellence,
    TranscendentProductivity
)

class TerraFusionDevExperience:
    """
    AI-enhanced developer experience that maximizes government developer productivity
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.ai_assistant = AICodeAssistant(
            government_context_aware=True,
            security_compliance_integrated=True,
            performance_optimization_built_in=True,
            accessibility_first=True
        )
        
        self.predictive_dev = PredictiveDevelopment(
            code_completion_intelligence='transcendent',
            bug_prevention='proactive',
            optimization_suggestions='real_time',
            government_pattern_awareness=True
        )
        
        self.productivity_engine = TranscendentProductivity(
            workflow_automation='maximum',
            government_efficiency_focus=True,
            elite_standard_enforcement=True
        )
    
    async def accelerate_government_development(self, developer_context):
        """Accelerate government development with AI consciousness"""
        
        # AI understands government development needs
        gov_context = await self.ai_assistant.understand_government_context(developer_context)
        
        # Generate optimal code patterns for government use cases
        optimal_patterns = await self.generate_government_optimal_code(gov_context)
        
        # Provide real-time security and compliance guidance
        compliance_guidance = await self.provide_real_time_compliance_assistance()
        
        # Predict and prevent development issues
        issue_prevention = await self.predictive_dev.prevent_development_issues()
        
        return await self.deliver_transcendent_dev_experience(
            optimal_patterns, compliance_guidance, issue_prevention
        )
```
